body.x: PhotoFast(www.photofast.tw) announced i-FlashDrive at 'Showstoppers' of 'CES 2014', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

This is only two way storage device between iOS and Mac/PC. The standard USB is compatible with all USB based computers, and at the other end it works with iPod touch, iPhone and iPad. So, you can transfer files with another person without network. There is a free App for this accessory that created a user interface for file management. It has built-in Music Play UI, Photo Import from CameraRoll, and voice recording. Those functions are handy.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
